clue.text: Sailor set to remove first coat

parts.note: Jack, or Jack Tar, is an old name for a sailor

indicators.note: the word set is to lose its opening letter

parts.note: the clue's word itself, minus its initial

explanation.surface: A sailor gets ready to take off his outer layer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to remove first' takes the S off SET, leaving ET to follow JACK.
explanation.definitionFit: A short outer garment worn over other clothes is a coat of this kind.

clue.text: English character seen 19 in lavatorial item? Nonsense!

parts.note: john is American slang for a toilet
bull is slang for rubbish talk

explanation.surface: Someone spots a famous Englishman on a toilet and dismisses it as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '19' is a clue number from the next column picked up by the scanner. JOHN BULL is the cartoon figure who personifies England.
explanation.definitionFit: The stout farmer figure is the national personification of England, as Uncle Sam is of the USA.

clue.text: Cautious group on drive, 21 containing energy

indicators.note: the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: a carful is as many people as one car takes on a drive
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A wary party of motorists bottling up their vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '21' is a clue number caught by the scanner. CARFUL is the number of people a car holds; E goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wary and taking pains to avoid risk is a synonym of cautious.

clue.text: Little hesitation blocking cuts in training activity

indicators.note: the hesitation sits in the way, inside the cuts

parts.note: excises means cuts out
er is the small sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A slight pause gets in the way of some cuts in a fitness routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Drills, workouts and practice routines are training activities.

clue.text: It beats what any old biddy can provide

definitions.text: It beats what any old biddy can provide

parts.words: It beats what any old biddy can provide
parts.note: a biddy is a hen, which lays eggs; the kitchen tool that beats those is described

explanation.surface: Something that outdoes whatever an old woman might offer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old biddy' suggests an old woman, but a biddy is also a hen, and 'beats' is what you do to its eggs in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen implement of looped wires used to beat the product of a hen.

clue.text: Spirit and money put into European biscuit

parts.note: gin is an alcoholic spirit

indicators.note: the money goes inside the European

parts.note: a German is a European
bread is slang for money

explanation.surface: Gin and cash are invested in a continental biscuit firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure-shaped ginger biscuit is a kind of biscuit, often called a cookie outside Britain.

clue.text: Hesitate to exclude one from exemption

indicators.note: the word for one is left out of the exemption

parts.note: a waiver is a formal exemption from a rule
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone dithers about leaving one person out of a release.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither or be irresolute is to hesitate.

clue.text: Bad to imprison supporter, one breaking the law

indicators.note: the bad word holds the others inside it like a cell

parts.note: ill means bad, as in ill will
a leg supports a table or a body
a means one

explanation.surface: Locking up a supporter would be wrong for someone who breaks the law.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unlawful is against the law, contrary to statute.

clue.text: Works in bakery, satisfying stated requirements?

indicators.note: said out loud, the word for requirements gives a different spelling

parts.note: needs are requirements

explanation.surface: Bakery work that meets what was asked for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'satisfying' is a link: the bakery verb sounds like the noun for requirements.
explanation.definitionFit: A baker works dough by pressing and folding it, which is kneading.

clue.text: No way you can stop people walking

definitions.text: No way you can stop people walking

parts.words: No way you can stop people walking
parts.note: read as a route on which nobody may bar walkers, rather than an exclamation of impossibility

explanation.surface: An exclamation that walkers simply cannot be halted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No way' looks like an emphatic denial; it is a literal way, a right of way open to all walkers.
explanation.definitionFit: A path with a legal right of way for pedestrians, which landowners may not block.

clue.text: Mix quail, heron, no duck? Actually, yes

definitions.text: Mix quail, heron, no duck? Actually, yes

indicators.note: the letters of the birds are to be stirred together
the zero is dropped from the heron

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A recipe for blending a quail with a heron, denying it is a duck, then admitting it is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no duck' takes the O out of HERON, leaving HERN; QUAIL plus HERN rearranged gives the answer, which is itself a duck, as 'Actually, yes' admits.
explanation.definitionFit: The harlequin is a sea duck with clownishly patterned plumage.

clue.text: Worth having University in valley

indicators.note: the university letter goes inside the valley

parts.note: a vale is a valley

explanation.surface: Merit comes from having a university set in a valley.
explanation.definitionFit: The monetary or moral merit of something is its worth.

clue.text: A company lie, backing large type of lens

indicators.note: the first three pieces run backwards

parts.note: a fib is a small lie
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A firm's untruth supports a big kind of lens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns A, CO, FIB into BIFOCA; L is added after.
explanation.definitionFit: Spectacle lenses with two focal zones, for near and distant sight, are one sort of lens.

clue.text: English garden spoiled, so very angry

indicators.note: the garden is messed up, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An English garden has been ruined, leaving its owner furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiled' rearranges GARDEN into NRAGED, after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Furious or incensed describes someone very angry.

clue.text: Eases down, taking left instead of right in expensive car

indicators.note: the letter for left replaces the letter for right in the car

parts.note: a Rolls, short for Rolls-Royce, is a luxury car

explanation.surface: Someone relaxes, steering left rather than right in a luxury car.
explanation.definitionFit: To lounge or sprawl lazily is to relax back, easing oneself down.

clue.text: Wire round all but first of rations in bundle

indicators.note: the wire goes around the other piece

parts.note: a cable is a wire

indicators.note: the rations lose their opening letter

parts.note: rations are food

explanation.surface: Wire wrapped around most of the provisions in a parcel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all but first of' takes F from FOOD, giving OOD, which CABLE goes round.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole lot, as in the whole kit and caboodle, is a collection or bundle.

clue.text: There aren't many wielding such power

definitions.text: There aren't many wielding such power

parts.words: There aren't many wielding such power
parts.note: describes a system where power lies with only a few people

explanation.surface: A remark that few people hold this kind of authority.
explanation.definitionFit: Government by a small group of the few is rule by a select elite.

clue.text: Good advert, say, lifting attempt to provide gismos?

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting turns the word upwards, so backwards

parts.note: eg, for example, is what 'say' means
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: A good advertisement lifting an attempt at gadgets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifting' reverses EG to GE in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Gadgets collectively, clever devices and gizmos, make up this word.

clue.text: Rather smelly wooden support out at sea

parts.note: food that has gone off smells bad
a shore is a timber prop supporting a wall

explanation.surface: A whiffy timber prop floating at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Away from the coast, on the water, is out at sea.

clue.text: Salvageable stuff family's auction items included

indicators.note: the auction items are taken inside the family

parts.note: fam is a short form of family
lots are items sold at auction

explanation.surface: A family's sale goods include things rescued from wrecks.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating wreckage of a ship or cargo, recoverable from the sea, is salvageable stuff.

clue.text: Resort business briefly shown in one article

indicators.note: the business word is placed in the other pieces

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a is the indefinite article
biz is a short informal form of business

explanation.surface: A holiday resort's trade appears briefly in one feature story.
explanation.definitionFit: The Balearic island famed for clubbing is a Mediterranean holiday resort.

clue.text: Briefly okay original

definitions.meaning: to sign with just your monogram, approving a document

explanation.definitionFit: To approve a document with your monogram is to okay it briefly; first or opening also means original.

clue.text: Handsome man getting notice on island

parts.note: an ad is a notice
taken as written

explanation.surface: A good-looking man spots a notice while on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: The beautiful youth loved by Venus in Greek myth, so any very handsome man.

clue.text: Party set-up with no 5 opening for milksop

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: the set-up loses its first letter
this word says some letters are taken away from the word it governs

parts.note: a format is a set-up or arrangement

explanation.surface: Party arrangements without an opening for a wimp.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '5' is a clue number caught by the scanner. 'with no opening' drops the F from FORMAT, leaving ORMAT after DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeble person who lets others walk all over them is a wimp.

clue.text: Name a vegetable raised, of American type

indicators.note: in a down clue the whole run is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a yam is a starchy root vegetable

explanation.surface: Name a vegetable that was grown in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' reverses the whole of N, A, YAM in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the ancient civilisation of Central America is one American type.

clue.text: Picture victory in form of racing

indicators.note: the victory goes inside the racing

parts.note: drag racing is sprint racing between two cars
a win is a victory

explanation.surface: A photograph of a victory in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A sketch made with pencil or pen is a picture.

clue.text: Unpleasant way to block 7 negative vote

indicators.note: the way sits inside the vote, obstructing it

parts.note: nay is a no vote
St is the abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: An unpleasant tactic for obstructing a no vote.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '7' is a clue number caught by the scanner.
explanation.definitionFit: Something disagreeable or horrid is unpleasant.

clue.text: Nothing, as a rule, can 8 satisfy this type

definitions.text: Nothing, as a rule, can 8 satisfy this type

parts.words: Nothing, as a rule, can 8 satisfy this type
parts.note: the phrase 'as a rule' is taken as a rule of government: nobody content with no rule at all

explanation.surface: A remark that this sort of person is never usually content.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '8' is a scanner pickup. 'Nothing, as a rule' reads as 'usually nothing', but the person meant wants no rule at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who wants all government abolished is satisfied only by no rule.

clue.text: Describes a man that 9 embraces this girl

indicators.note: the phrase holds the name within its letters

explanation.surface: A woman sketching a man who hugs her.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '9' is a scanner pickup. The name runs from the end of 'Describes' through 'a man' into 'that'.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so a girl, as the clue's 'this girl' asks.

clue.text: In minor action, king 16 was trapped thus?

definitions.meaning: subsidiary action going on beside the main one
a chess king is cornered through the moves of the game, read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: The stray '16' is a scanner pickup. Split into two words, the answer says how a chess king gets trapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Subsidiary stage business is secondary action; a king checkmated in chess is trapped by play.
